command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group inventory-readers =="
sudo -n groupadd inventory-readers
echo "== create user inventorysvc =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
echo "== chown recursively =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
echo "== chmod dirs 750 =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
echo "== chmod files 640 =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;
echo "== verify =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "== contents preserved =="
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/config.json
